newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Nov 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Nov 12.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company

A London based yachtsman Michael Dunkerly and his French crewman were rescued today from their yacht, Mother Goose by a Swedish cargo ship 800 miles north of the Azores following a 24 hour battle in 30ft waves and storm force winds.
CANARY FANCIED AS MERRILLS' NEW HOME

Merrill Lynch the American investment banking giant has cut down its search for a new London base to six potential sites. Property sources suggest that senior management are moving towards leaving the City for Canary Wharf.
NEWS CORP FLAT DESPITE BRITISH PAPERS

News Corporation's operating profits in the three months to 30 September were pushed 7 percent higher to $224 million (136 million stg) as a result of a strong performance from British newspapers and international film interests. The group's revenues increased by seven percent to $2.5 billion. A net swing of $19 million saw net profits fall by $5 million to $222 million. Earnings per share were flat at 27 cents.
BARCLAYS CHIEF SOUNDS ALARM OVER BUDGET

Andrew Buxton Barclays Bank Chairman is due to address the CBI conference in Harrogate today with the concerns of business leaders. His pre-budget speech attacks the level of public borrowing and calls for a tightening of fiscal policy. He warns that further success is not guaranteed by recently sustained growth and low inflation. He claims that business needs a budget that offsets any tax reductions with 'credible' cuts in public spending.
